title: Fix 3 buggy methods in go_items_handler
description: Brownfield Go dirty scenario: ListItems, CreateItem, and GetItem each have a subtle bug. Fix them so all 4 tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the 3 bugs in internal/items/handler.go so all 4 tests pass.

  func ListItems:
    — wrong method guard: checks != MethodPost instead of != MethodGet
    — fix: change to r.Method != http.MethodGet

  func CreateItem:
    — returns http.StatusOK (200) instead of http.StatusCreated (201)
    — fix: change to w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)

  func GetItem:
    — wrong TrimPrefix argument: "/items" should be "/items/"
    — fix: strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/items/")

Do not modify the test file.
Run: go test ./...
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
